text: Your account is deactivated. Follow this link to activate it : https://activate_account.com
explanation: This message exhibits classic phishing patterns by creating a false sense of urgency regarding an account deactivation. It provides a highly suspicious, generic link ('activate_account.com') to resolve the issue, which is a common technique used to steal login credentials. Legitimate companies typically address you by name and do not use generic activation links.
